'''Ardon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived in the [[Kerritamba Village]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] world of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]]. He was an elder of the village and adviser to its [[Chief/Legends|chief]], [[Kerritamba]].

==History==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], Kerritamba Village was at war with another group within the Kkowir Forest known as the [[Outcasts (Kashyyyk)|Outcasts]]. Ardon tasked the village's new [[Arena Champion]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], with two tasks to further combat the Outcast threat. Ardon instructed the spacer to enter the Outcast's lair and defeat 5 of their [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. When the spacer returned, they were rewarded with 5,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The final task that Ardon set upon the spacer was to take out one of the Outcast's top officials, a [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] known as [[Exemplar (title)|Exemplar]] [[Zheus]]. The spacer located Zheus, who was skulking around the [[Great Tree (Kashyyyk)|Spirit of Nyenthi'Oris]], and slew him. The spacer returned to Ardon, who rewarded them with 5,000 credits and named them the Blood Hunter of Kerritamba Village.

==Behind the scenes==
Ardon is a non-playable character in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He was added to the game in [[2005]] with the expansion pack ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''.
